description: This PHP class defines the SubTotal model extension in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It calculates the subtotal of the cart items and updates the totals array accordingly.

classes.name: SubTotal
classes.description: Class responsible for calculating and adding the subtotal to the total amount during checkout processing.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the subtotal of cart items, appends the subtotal information to the totals array, and updates the total amount.
